statement: ∀ (Q : LR.Residue p K), letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra; ∀ (f : LR.MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[LR.R p] LR.MR p M), LR.IotaSpec p M f → Function.Injective f → LR.GammaPure p K M Q.phi G → ∀ (F : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (LR.VK K M)), LR.Lift K M F g → ∀ (z w : LR.MR p M) (c : ℤ), F (f z) = (c : ℂ) • f w → g (G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] z)) = (c : K) • G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] w)
proof:
intro Q
letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
intro f G hf hinj hG F g hg z w c he
rcases hg with ⟨fm, hfm, hgm⟩
let FR : Module.End (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M) := fm.baseChange (LR.R p)
have hFR : ∀ z : LR.MR p M, f (FR z) = F (f z) := by
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m =>
    simp only [FR, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hf.1, hfm, map_smul]
  | add z w hz hw => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hw
have hcomm : ∀ z : LR.MR p M, g (G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] z)) = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] FR z) := by
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul r m => simp only [FR, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hG.2, mul_one, hgm]
  | add z w hz hw => simpa only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hw
have hz : FR z = c • w := hinj (by rw [hFR, he]; simp [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul])
rw [hcomm, hz]
simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_zsmul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

checked : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_2) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ)
  (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (rho : ↥LR.L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥LR.L) (v : V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
    LR.N1 l (rho x) (rho y) (rho h) v →
      LR.N2 p l K M rho x y h v →
        ∀ (Q : LR.Residue p K) (f : LR.MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(LR.R p)] LR.MR p M),
          LR.IotaSpec p M f →
            Function.Injective ⇑f →
              LR.GammaPure p K M Q.phi G →
                ∀ (F : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (LR.VK K M)),
                  LR.Lift K M F g →
                    ∀ (z w : LR.MR p M) (c : ℤ),
                      F (f z) = ↑c • f w → g (G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(LR.R p)] z)) = ↑c • G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(LR.R p)] w)
